blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Sasiwararin Atsawahirankarn of Thailand was crowned as Miss Asia Pacific International 2026, her victory capping weeks of activities that saw the delegates touring the entire province. Sasiwararin bested 37 other aspirants from different countries and territories around the world to succeed Brazilian queen Isabela Fernandes in ceremonies held at Mactan Expo in Lapu-Lapu City on Saturday evening, Oct. 10. Finishing as first runner-up was Costa Rica’s Gia Angelique Franceschi, while South Africa’s Nompumelelo Malindi settled for second runner-up.
